verdict.rationale: Adyen's docs say the Terminal API can issue refunds from the point of sale, and the refund page describes referenced and unreferenced refund types, with unreferenced refunds returning any amount to any card presented. Refunds can also be issued from the Customer Area dashboard, so all three channels in the story (POS, dashboard, API) are covered. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that referenced refunds support partial amounts and return funds to the original card (the snippet is truncated), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
